QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_32

question.text: SEBI has specified that every Social Stock Exchange shall constitute a Social Stock Exchange Governing Council (SGC) with representation drawn from which categories?

answer.text: Only the exchange management and SEBI nominees.
Philanthropic and social sectors (public/private donors), Non-Profit Organisations, Information Repositories, Social Impact Investors, etc. — a balanced representation.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.2.6, every SSE shall constitute an SGC with balanced representation drawn from various categories of stakeholders — Philanthropic and social sectors (public/private donors), Non-profit organisations, Information Repositories, Social Impact Investors etc. The SGC provides oversight and guidance on registration, fundraising and disclosures by social enterprises. The Trap: Options A, B and D each narrow the mandate to a single constituency, contradicting the 'balanced representation' principle. Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C (Compliance) treat segmental governing councils for SME, debt, IGP. XIX-A/B/C/D/E treat AIF trustees — a different governance layer.
